LESSON: ULUM AL-HADITH HADITH COMPILATION OF HADITH

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith
Topic 2.1: Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why was it important to collect and compile Hadith?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the six authentic Books of Hadith as a source of guidance
2. describe the characteristics of different classes of Hadith (sahih, hasan, and dhai
3. explain reasons for the classification of Hadith for authenticity
4. describe the process of collection and compilation of Hadith during the period of the Tabi'in
5. appreciate the collection and compilation of Hadith as a source of Islamic sharia. Tabi’in and present on charts/PowerPoint

What this means

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify the six authentic Books of Hadith as a source of guidance.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

3. Practise this skill: describe the characteristics of different classes of Hadith (sahih, hasan, and dhai.
4. Practise this skill: explain reasons for the classification of Hadith for authenticity.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 9 learner study Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why was it important to collect and compile Hadith?
2. Why is Hadith classified?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify the six authentic Books of Hadith as a source of guidance.
